A History of God: The 4000 Year Quest of Judaism, Christianity and Islam

Whatever the origins of Judaism, Psalms is a book of poetry written sometime after the establishment of the Kingdom of Israel-- that is, kind of late in the Old Testament.

The concept of a Divine Council ruled by God is called Henotheism -- there's only one God you need to worry about, the rest are just toadies. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henotheism

If you're interested in Psalms as a book of literature, I really recommend Robert Alter's translation. He's a professor of ancient Hebrew literature, and takes it seriously as a book of poetry http://www.amazon.com/The-Book-Psalms-Translation-Commentary/dp/0393337049
